goal: Secure a directed-spending earmark to fund a university-affiliated advanced-materials research center.

clientContextFixture.profileSummary: State research university; needs both a Hill sponsor and a supportive federal agency letter to strengthen the earmark case.

nodes.subject: deliverable
nodes.title: Draft the research-center proposal and budget justification

nodes.subject: member
nodes.title: Secure a member sponsor for the earmark request

nodes.subject: agency
nodes.title: Request a letter of support from the relevant federal agency

nodes.subject: ask
nodes.title: Finalize the funding request amount and scope

nodes.subject: submission
nodes.title: Submit the earmark request through the sponsor office

nodes.subject: committee
nodes.title: Track the request through committee consideration

nodes.subject: outcome
nodes.title: Earmark included in final enacted bill

orderingAssertions.description: sponsor and agency-letter tracks both precede finalizing the ask

notes: Parallel member-sponsor + agency-letter tracks (n2/n3) converging on the funding decision (n4) — same fan-out/fan-in shape as the coalition/procurement goldens but for a single-institution earmark.
